normalized.title: Measures to support the implementation of the EU Chips Act Pillar III
normalized.description:
To move forward with the implementation of the different tasks under the pillar III of the Chips Act and provide support to the European Semiconductor Board, we need to setup a service contract providing analytical, methodological and administrative support.
The objectives of this procurement are to provide analytical, methodological and administrative support to the Commission, in order to implement the EU Chips Act pillar III. Objectives include developing a methodology to address the requirements regarding the strategic mapping, monitoring and crisis activation, defining in a more operational way the critical sectors and providing support during crisis, providing analytical support (including commercial data) for all policy files relative to the semiconductor value chain.
The results will be used by the Commission and the European Semiconductor Board to fulfil the obligations stemming from the European Chips Act Pillar III.

Title: Finland – Data services – Sentinel and Landsat satellite data API
Procedure title: Sentinel and Landsat satellite data API
Description: We are seeking for a provider of a Cloud API service for online satellite data archive and processing framework containing the following satellite platforms: Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2 (L1C and L2A), Sentinel-3, Landsat-5, Landsat-7, Landsat-8 and Lansat-9. For current missions, the archive must be updated with NRT data for the whole contract period. The Cloud API must support configurable WMS-service for web map visualization, and other APIs for accessing pixel level reflectance data and computing zonal statistics of earth observation products. The main minimum criteria Please note! Minimum criteria are described more precisely and broadly in the chapter Procurement object criteria of this call for tenders. The service must be already existing and have an existing customer base. The Cloud API must provide: 1. OGC WMS-APIs for web map visualization 2. an API for computing zonal statistics of earth observation (EO) products 3. an API to provide download access to pixel level reflectance data The APIs must support EO-product configuration using Javascript embedded in the API call, to ensure continuity of SYKEs existing production framework. The contract must contain at least 120 million OGC WMS-requests for 12-month contract period at the maximum rate of 3000 requests per minute (1 WMS-request = 256 x 256 pixels).
